widgets_values:
## Shot look match across a sequence Workflow for Radiance:

1. Read (top): the edited sequence or generated shots. Read (bottom): the hero/reference frame.
2. Scene Cut Detect finds the cuts; its score plot shows in the small viewer.
3. Scene Cut Split takes one shot by shot_index: step it 0, 1, 2... and queue once per shot.
4. Grade Match matches that shot to the reference; CDL adds a shared trim.
5. QC checks clipping and banding; Write saves each shot as an EXR sequence. Put the shot number in filename so shots don't overwrite each other.
Viewer: matched shot vs the original.

- Radiance: [Documentation](https://www.fxtdstudios.com/comfyu-radiance-docs/)
- Radiance: [GitHub](https://github.com/FXTD-Studios/radiance)

## Radiance Report Issues :
To report any issues with Radiance nodes, [go to GitHub](https://github.com/FXTD-Studios/radiance/issues)

## Model Links (for Local Users)

None: this workflow needs no model.

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
